characterList.description: A male with short brown hair, wearing glasses, a green t-shirt, and a dark blue zip-up hoodie. He stands in front of a white board and uses markers to explain physics concepts.
characterList.name: Professor

content_metadata.description: A physics lesson focusing on the concept of free body diagrams taught by a Professor using a whiteboard and markers.

qAndA.question: What color marker does the Professor use to draw the force vector for gravity?

qAndA.answer: He uses a single blue dot.
qAndA.question: How does the Professor represent the book in his free body diagram?

qAndA.answer: The length of the normal force vector increases.
qAndA.question: How does the length of the normal force vector change when the Professor adds a downward force from his hand?

qAndA.answer: The block will start to move upwards because the forces are no longer balanced.
qAndA.question: What happens to the block if the table pushes with a force of 15 Newtons?

qAndA.answer: The normal force exerted by the table is not constant and can vary depending on other forces acting on the object.
qAndA.question: What does the Professor suggest about the nature of the normal force exerted by the table?

The Professor speaks to the camera, introducing the topic of free body diagrams

characterInteraction.description: The Professor directly addresses the viewer, engaging them in the topic.

mood.description: Curious - The Professor's opening remarks and introduction of the topic spark interest and set a tone of exploration.

narrativeProgression.description: The Professor introduces himself and the topic of free body diagrams.

scenes.thematicElements: Introduction to free body diagrams, forces in physics.
scenes.title: Introduction and Explanation

activities.description: The Professor draws diagrams on the whiteboard and explains the concept of free body diagrams using a book on a table as an example.

characterInteraction.description: The Professor continues to directly address the viewer, walking them through the problem step by step.

mood.description: Curious - The Professor's step-by-step explanation maintains the viewer's interest and encourages further learning.

narrativeProgression.description: The Professor explains free body diagrams with an example of a book resting on a table.
Adds a force from his hand pushing down on the book.

scenes.thematicElements: Forces in equilibrium, normal force, gravity, vector addition.
scenes.title: Free Body Diagram Example 1

activities.description: The Professor explains the addition of the hand force to the free body diagram.
He contemplates a more complex example.

characterInteraction.description: The Professor maintains engagement with the viewer but shifts from a teaching tone to one of pondering.

mood.description: Pensive - The Professor's thoughtful pauses and contemplation of the next example create a sense of reflection and anticipation for what's to come.

keyMoments.changeDescription: Mood shift from detailed explanations to contemplation of the next step.

narrativeProgression.description: The Professor modifies the free body diagram to include the hand force and teases a more complex example.

scenes.thematicElements: Free body diagrams with multiple forces, equilibrium, changing motion.
scenes.title: Transition to More Complex Example

climax.description: When the Professor introduces the idea of the table pushing with a slightly higher force, challenging the current state of equilibrium.

storylines.description: The Professor teaches the concept of free body diagrams through increasingly complex examples.
